_comment: Chapter 3 of the story revamp (docs/gameplay/23 §4): the whole ledger (three pages, ledger_pages 3): Leo's line, and Kai's sister Mira (c3.ledger: the quest done).

text.zh_TW: 三頁名冊拼在一起。最下面一行寫著：「橡木村，農夫家——有記號的孩子：里歐。主人親自處理。」再往上一行……
text.en: The three pages fit together. The last line reads: "Oakhollow, the farmer's house: the marked child, Leo. To be handled by the Master." One line above it...

text.zh_TW: 凱的手在發抖：「『王都，騎士家——米菈，十二歲。』……是我妹妹。」他握緊劍。「我一直以為她只是被派去遠方的修道院。」
text.en: Kai's hands are shaking. "'The capital, a knight's house: Mira, twelve.'... That's my little sister." He grips his sword. "I thought she'd been sent to a convent far away."

text.zh_TW: 凱把名冊收好，聲音很低：「……灰面。我一定要問清楚。」
text.en: Kai folds the ledger away, his voice low. "...Grey Mask. I'm going to get answers."
